title: ProjectSetSettings
description: `project.set_settings` params: fields left out keep their current value.

autosave_interval_s.description: Seconds after the last edit before the desktop autosaves (0 disables).

cache_limit_bytes.description: Layer cache cap in bytes (≥ 16 MiB).

wind.description: Shared wind of the world: every wind-driven node without its own `wind_*` setting follows it.

memory_budget_bytes.description: Memory budget for evaluations, bytes (≥ 256 MiB; default 4 GiB).

Wind.description:
Shared weather state: the prevailing wind. Every wind-driven node (dunes, yardangs, snow
scour, the wind sea) follows it unless the node sets its own `wind_*` parameter.

azimuth_deg.description: Direction the wind blows FROM, degrees clockwise from north (270 = westerly).

speed_mps.description: Speed 10 m above the ground, m/s (8 = a moderate breeze).
